domain_equations.z_score_convention: All-tumor platform-specific log-expression mean and population SD (ddof=0): z(g) = (log_expr(g) - mean(g)) / sd_ddof0(g)
domain_equations.D1_trafficking: CXCR3_Trafficking - TGFB_CAF_Barrier, where CXCR3_Trafficking = mean(z(CXCL9, CXCL10, CXCL11, CXCR3)) and TGFB_CAF_Barrier = mean(z(TGFB1, ACTA2, FAP, COL1A1, FN1, THBS1))
domain_equations.D2_presentation: APM_TAP_Score = mean(z(TAP1, TAP2, PSMB8, PSMB9, B2M, HLA-A, HLA-B, HLA-C)); APM_Intact = (APM_TAP_Score >= MSS_Q20) AND (z(TAP1) >= MSS_Q20) AND (z(TAP2) >= MSS_Q20) AND (z(PSMB8) >= MSS_Q20)
domain_equations.D4_triad: S_triad = 0.2*(z(CD8A) + z(CD8B) + z(CD4) + z(IL7R) + z(TCF7)) - 0.5*(z(FOXP3) + z(IL2RA))
domain_equations.D5_myeloid: -0.5 * (Z(KRAS_IRF2_CXCL3_Axis) + Z(SPP1_Core_Barrier)), where KRAS_IRF2_CXCL3_Axis = z(CXCL3) + z(CXCL8) + z(CD47) + z(SLC25A22) - z(IRF2) and SPP1_Core_Barrier = 0.25*(z(SPP1) + z(CXCL12) + z(ITGAM) + z(CD68))
domain_equations.STC1010_Readiness_Score: mean(Z_domain(D1..D6)) — descriptive 6-domain summary; do not conflate with D1_D2_Vaccine_Effector_Index

KRAS_G12D_vs_WT_CD47.clinical_rule: KRAS_G12D_LOW_CD47_NO_EMPIRIC_ANTI_CD47: KRAS G12D MSS CRC exhibits significantly LOWER CD47 expression (even after CD8+PTPRC residualization); do not assign empiric anti-CD47/SIRPalpha blockade on genotype alone.

STRATUM_1_DIRECT_VACCINE_PERMISSIVE.criteria: D1 > 0 AND APM_Intact == True (and not overridden by Stratum 4 liver_metastasis or TGFB_CAF_Barrier > Q75)
STRATUM_1_DIRECT_VACCINE_PERMISSIVE.regimen_recommendation: Direct STC-1010 + low-dose Cyclophosphamide + GM-CSF + mFOLFOX6 + Bevacizumab +/- anti-PD-1/PD-L1 (BreAK CRC-001 core permissive stratum)

STRATUM_2_FOLFOX_TAP_PRIMING_LEAD_IN.criteria: D1 > 0 BUT APM_Intact == False (TAP1/TAP2/PSMB8/APM_TAP_Score < MSS Q20) with B2M structurally intact
STRATUM_2_FOLFOX_TAP_PRIMING_LEAD_IN.regimen_recommendation: 2-cycle mFOLFOX6 immunogenic cell death (ICD) + IFN-gamma induction lead-in prior to first STC-1010 intradermal vaccination, with mandatory repeat TAP1/TAP2/HLA-I check; if b2m_truncating_lof == True, emit B2M_STRUCTURAL_LOSS_NK_INNATE_REQUIRED flag.

STRATUM_3_BEVACIZUMAB_AND_CY_MANDATE.criteria: VEGF_TOX_Exhaustion > Q75 OR Treg_Load > Q75 OR SPP1_Core_Barrier > Q75
STRATUM_3_BEVACIZUMAB_AND_CY_MANDATE.regimen_recommendation: Mandatory Bevacizumab (anti-VEGF endothelial/TOX normalization) + low-dose metronomic Cyclophosphamide (FOXP3/IL2RA Treg depletion) + CSF1R/CXCR2 myeloid conditioning; if kras_g12d == True, emit KRAS_G12D_LOW_CD47_NO_EMPIRIC_ANTI_CD47 (CD47 Cliff's delta = -0.295).

STRATUM_4_STROMAL_TGFB_AND_HEPATIC_CONVE.criteria: D1 <= 0 OR TGFB_CAF_Barrier > Q75 OR liver_metastasis == True
STRATUM_4_STROMAL_TGFB_AND_HEPATIC_CONVE.regimen_recommendation: Hold naked STC-1010 monotherapy/standard priming; require stromal TGF-beta/FAP remodeling and/or hepatic-directed conditioning + mFOLFOX6 + Bevacizumab conversion before STC-1010 vaccination.
